The first Shoprite opened in Wynberg, Cape Town, in 1966. In 1979 a group led by Whitey Basson, backed by Christo Wiese, bought the business: eight stores, for one million rand. In 1986 it listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, worth about R29 million. In 1991 it bought Checkers for R55 million. And at the end of 1997 it bought OK Bazaars, a famous old chain, for one rand.
